<script>
(function(){
  var r=window.dxUpdateResult;
  if(r){window.dxUpdateResult=function(m,v){r(m,v);var n=document.getElementById('dx-verbar-note');if(n&&m)n.textContent=m;};}
  var c=window.dxCheckUpdate;
  if(c){window.dxCheckUpdate=function(){
    var n=document.getElementById('dx-verbar-note');
    if(n)n.textContent='正在检查…';
    c.apply(window,arguments);
    var tries=0;
    var t=setInterval(function(){
      tries++;
      var src=document.getElementById('dx-update-note'), stt=document.getElementById('dx-update-state');
      var txt=(src&&src.textContent)||'';
      if(txt&&txt.indexOf('正在逐个')<0){
        clearInterval(t);
        var m=txt.match(/服务器 v([0-9.\-]+)/);
        var shown=(stt?stt.textContent:'')+(txt?' · '+txt:'');
        if(m){
          var sv=Number(String(m[1]).replace(/[.\-]/g,''));
          if(sv&&sv<window.DX_APP_VERSION)shown='本机 v'+window.dxVerText(window.DX_APP_VERSION)+' 已是最新 ✓ · 更新服务器还停在 v'+m[1]+'（下次发布后手机可自动更新）';
        }
        if(n)n.textContent=shown;
      }
      if(tries>30)clearInterval(t);
    },400);
  };}
})();
</script>
</body>
